svg.title: AWS Migration Process
svg.desc: AWS Migration Process. Assess, mobilize, then migrate and modernize: a business case, a landing zone and migration waves that move a portfolio to AWS. Step 1, A big-bang weekend: Plan v1 switches all 120 workloads in one weekend: no dependency map, no licence check, no way back. Step 2, Assess: know the estate: Assess: map 120 workloads and their dependencies, make the business case, give each workload one R. Step 3, Mobilize: lay foundations: Mobilize: a landing zone, a cloud centre of excellence, a pilot of five workloads and a wave plan. Step 4, Migrate, then modernize: A wave every two weeks: replicate, test, cut over or roll back, then switch off. Pitfalls in amber.

g.text: Plan v1 switches all 120 workloads in one weekend: no dependency map, no licence check, no way back.
Assess: map 120 workloads and their dependencies, make the business case, give each workload one R.
Mobilize: a landing zone, a cloud centre of excellence, a pilot of five workloads and a wave plan.
A wave every two weeks: replicate, test, cut over or roll back, then switch off. Pitfalls in amber.
nobody knows what talks to what
copy the VMs in Q3, switch in Q4
every problem lands on one Monday
modernise, one workload at a time
catalog: rebuilt on its own track
wave 1 lands in a bare account
an app split from its database
a failed cutover has no way back
waves slip, the lease runs out
the bill beats the business case
→ price them before picking an R
